title: Commit revision-bound assessments and reusable semantic caches
summary: Make assessment the durable unit of computation. Record component results and context, reusing unchanged evidence judgments across audiences or clock movement only when their declared inputs remain equivalent.
in_scope: Semantic cache keys and qualification-aware reuse
implementation: Construct input from consistent matter, evidence, candidate-set, profile, and context reads.
Compose conclusions, gaps, dimensions, and permitted proposals with exact receipts.
Key caches by semantic dependencies and temporal equivalence, excluding irrelevant delivery wrappers.
Check all revisions, negative scopes, and epoch at commit; retain stale attempts as non-current.

acceptance.criterion: Stale input prevents assessment from becoming current.
acceptance.verification: Pause evaluation, change evidence, then attempt commit.

acceptance.criterion: Audience-independent evidence can be reused while audience-sensitive judgment cannot.
acceptance.verification: Inspect invocation counts and manifests across two audiences.

acceptance.criterion: Policy change and external evidence change have different cause labels.
acceptance.verification: Reassess fixed evidence under new policy, then new evidence under fixed policy.

tests: Title changes invalidate only consumers of title.
Deadline crossing reuses unchanged semantic support.
Expired qualification is not revived by cache.
risks: An incomplete cache key can reuse judgments under changed meanings or coverage.

reuse.application: Adapt version-checked derived state into immutable neutral assessments and caches.
